text: By far Edinburgh's highest-crime ward: 267.7 crimes per 1,000 population in 2023/24, more than double the next-highest ward and driven by the dense concentration of pubs, clubs, tourist footfall and retail theft in the Old Town/New Town core. Genuine, dated local press coverage also documents recurring nightlife-related disturbances specifically around the Cowgate/Grassmarket area: on the night of 20 September 2025 police responded to a disturbance outside a Grassmarket bar in which a 28-year-old man was hospitalised and a 39-year-old man was arrested and charged (Edinburgh News, 21 Sep 2025). Day and night are both red here on the strength of the underlying rate alone; the Cowgate/Grassmarket incident is additional, specific corroboration for the night rating rather than the basis for it.
sources: Churchill Support Services / Scottish Daily Express, 28 Nov 2024
